headline: Oil Falls 1.57 Percent To $100.16 As Money Leaves The Energy Pipe
narrative: Oil fell 1.57 percent to $100.16, with money leaving the energy pipe. Gold rose 0.81 percent to $4,071.3 and silver rose 0.75 percent to $54.51, so the precious-metals pipe took the bid the energy pipe gave up. The S&P 500 rose 0.56 percent to 7,719.72, a bid in the equity pipe beside the energy offer.
author: jordan
